title: getSummary request
description: GET /v1/summaries/{summaryId} - request. One immutable summary with provenance (also used by ms-audit-ledger for regulatory reconstruction).
$comment: Source: DISENO S2 (e), AP-S2; DISENO 4.8 SX-01b, SX-06; ADR-020; PRD RF-047, RNF-025. Audience: INTERNAL service-to-service - SX-01b and SX-06 callee. Residency: GLOBAL (home region); TEMPLATE_PUBLIC content only, may be read cross-region; requests and responses never carry engagementId/firmId/userId (RF-056, RF-092). Idempotency: safe read (GET). Pagination: none (single resource).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).
